newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yaohan Int'l shr deal extended to May 2.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Int'l shr deal extended to May 2.

text.p: Yaohan International Holdings Ltd said its substantial shareholder Yaohan International Co Ltd and third party Pacific Concord Holding Ltd had agreed to extend completion of a share deal to May 2 from April 11.
"The condition to which completion of the disposal is subject has not been fulfilled," Yoahan said in the statement.
It said Yaohan International Co and Pacific Concord had agreed to extend the period for fulfilment of the condition to May 2. No further details were given.

Earlier this month, the 39.735 percent controlling shareholder Yaohan International Co had agreed to sell 196.4 million shares or 19.87 percent stake of Yaohan International Holdings to Pacific Concord at HK$0.684 per share.
Shares of Yaohan International Holdings fell HK$0.02 to HK$0.66 in late morning.
